enemy.warden.desc: Mini-boss: heavy blows, a charge and a ground stomp. Enrages when half defeated.
enemy.frostqueen.desc: Boss: ice shards in fans and rings, gliding charges, teleportation and bats. Three phases.
enemy.pyromancer.desc: Mini-boss: keeps its distance, hurls fireballs and novas, and summons wisps.
enemy.forgelord.desc: Boss: hammer and shockwave, fireball barrages, summoned knights, final enrage. Three phases.
enemy.wraith.desc: Flying mini-boss: vanishes and reappears, fires dark bolts.
enemy.voidlord.desc: Final boss: teleportation, spirals, rings, danger zones and summons. Four phases.
